checks.label: Hips sagging
checks.message: Squeeze your glutes and abs. Lift your hips into one straight line.

checks.label: Hips too high
checks.message: Lower your hips so your body is one straight line.

checks.label: Head dropping
checks.message: Look at the floor just ahead of your hands and keep your neck long.

camera.title: Film from the side
steps: Prop your phone or laptop 2.5 to 3 m away, at about hip height, so the camera sees you side-on (90 degrees).
Keep your whole body in frame, from your head to your feet, and leave some space above and below.
Light the room from the front or above. A bright window behind you makes the camera lose your outline.
Wear fitted clothing so your joints are visible. Keep the weights or machine from covering the side facing the camera.
camera.note: Camera side-on at floor level, about 2 m away, with your whole body in frame. The rule starts timing after the camera has seen you in a plank for a moment.

guidance.accuracy: This is a warm-up helper with simple rules. It counts reps and flags the most common mistakes, nothing more.
